column2: A belt that carries entities from one end to the other. It has a length and a speed, and each entity takes a pitch of belt: its item length plus the gap kept free after it. So it holds at most length ÷ pitch entities and carries at most speed ÷ pitch per time unit. Accumulating: entities queue up at the end while the rest keep moving; otherwise the whole belt stops.
column3: Traka koja nosi entitete sa jednog kraja na drugi. Ima dužinu i brzinu, a svaki entitet zauzima korak trake: dužinu svog predmeta plus razmak koji ostaje slobodan iza njega. Zato nosi najviše dužina ÷ korak entiteta i prenosi najviše brzina ÷ korak po jedinici vremena. Akumulacija: entiteti se redaju na kraju dok se ostali nastavljaju da se kreću; inače staje cela traka.

column3: Model nema blok „Odlasci”, pa se ne meri vreme u sistemu. Dodajte blok „Odlasci”.

column2: No entity can reach {block} from an Arrivals block. Connect it to a block that entities pass through.
column3: Nijedan entitet ne može da stigne do bloka {block} iz bloka „Dolasci”. Povežite ga sa blokom kroz koji entiteti prolaze.

column2: Entities in {block} can never reach a Departures block. Connect it on towards Departures.
column3: Entiteti u bloku {block} nikada ne mogu da stignu do bloka „Odlasci”. Povežite ga dalje ka bloku „Odlasci”.

column2: Set the “{state}” power of {block} to a number of kilowatts, 0 or more.
column3: Postavite snagu „{state}” bloka {block} na broj kilovata, 0 ili više.

column2: Set the warm-up of the experiment to 0 or more.
column3: Postavite zagrevanje eksperimenta na 0 ili više.

column2: Set the duration of the experiment to more than 0.
column3: Postavite trajanje eksperimenta na više od 0.

column2: Set the number of runs of the experiment to 1 or more.
column3: Postavite broj pokretanja eksperimenta na 1 ili više.

column2: Set the layout scale (length units per drawing unit) to a finite number above 0.
column3: Postavite razmeru crteža (jedinica dužine po jedinici crteža) na konačan broj iznad 0.

column2: A property of {block} has no name. Give it a name, or remove it.
column3: Jedno svojstvo bloka {block} nema ime. Dajte mu ime ili ga uklonite.

column2: {block} sets the property “{name}” twice. Keep one of them.
column3: Blok {block} dva puta postavlja svojstvo „{name}”. Zadržite jedno.

column2: The property “{name}” of {block} needs shares that are not negative and add up to more than 0. Change the shares.
column3: Svojstvo „{name}” bloka {block} zahteva udele koji nisu negativni i sabiraju se u više od 0. Promenite udele.

column2: The property “{name}” has the type “{type2}” on {block} but “{type}” on another block. Give it one type everywhere.
column3: Svojstvo „{name}” ima tip „{type2}” na bloku {block}, a tip „{type}” na drugom bloku. Zadajte mu jedan tip svuda.

column2: The value of the property “{name}” on {block} does not fit its type, “{type}”. Change the value or the type.
column3: Vrednost svojstva „{name}” na bloku {block} ne odgovara njegovom tipu „{type}”. Promenite vrednost ili tip.

column2: The expression for the property “{name}” on {block} cannot be used: {error}. Correct “{expression}”.
column3: Izraz za svojstvo „{name}” na bloku {block} ne može da se koristi: {error}. Ispravite „{expression}”.

column2: {block} reads the property “{name}”, which no block sets, so it would read as empty. Set it on an earlier block, or correct the name.
column3: Blok {block} čita svojstvo „{name}” koje nijedan blok ne postavlja, pa će biti pročitano kao prazno. Postavite ga na ranijem bloku ili ispravite ime.

column2: The setup of {block} has times for particular changes but no property to watch. Choose a property under “Only when this property changes”.
column3: Priprema bloka {block} ima vremena za određene promene, ali nema svojstvo koje se prati. Izaberite svojstvo u polju „Samo kada se ovo svojstvo promeni”.

column2: {block} has times for particular values but no property to read them from. Choose a property under “Service time by property”.
column3: Blok {block} ima vremena za određene vrednosti, ali nema svojstvo iz koga ih čita. Izaberite svojstvo u polju „Vreme posluživanja prema svojstvu”.

column2: {block} has two times for the value “{value}”. Keep one.
column3: Blok {block} ima dva vremena za vrednost „{value}”. Zadržite jedno.

column2: Set the time of {block} for the value “{value}” to a mean of 0 or more.
column3: Postavite vreme bloka {block} za vrednost „{value}” na srednju vrednost 0 ili više.

column2: The scrap at {block} counts against {other}, which is not a task with a resource. Choose a task with a resource.
column3: Škart kod bloka {block} računa se prema bloku {other}, koji nije zadatak s resursom. Izaberite zadatak s resursom.

column2: Set “Planned run time per item” of {block} to a mean above 0.
column3: Postavite „Planirano vreme rada po delu” bloka {block} na srednju vrednost iznad 0.

column2: Set “Time before giving up” of {block} to a mean of 0 or more.
column3: Postavite „Vreme do odustajanja” bloka {block} na srednju vrednost 0 ili više.

column2: The flow {flow} is ticked “Gave up”, but only a task with a resource and a “Time before giving up” sends entities that give up. Untick it, or set a “Time before giving up” on {block}.
column3: Tok {flow} je označen kao „Odustalo”, ali entitete koji odustaju šalje samo zadatak s resursom sa postavljenim „Vreme do odustajanja”. Uklonite oznaku ili postavite „Vreme do odustajanja” na bloku {block}.

column2: {count} flows out of {block} are ticked “{way}”; at most one can be. Untick all but one.
column3: {count} tokova iz bloka {block} označeno je kao „{way}”, a najviše jedan može biti. Uklonite oznaku sa svih osim jednog.

column2: The flow {flow} is ticked “Turned away”, but only a task with a resource and a limited waiting room turns entities away. Untick it, or limit the waiting room of {block}.
column3: Tok {flow} je označen kao „Odbijeni”, ali entitete odbija samo zadatak s resursom i ograničenom čekaonicom. Uklonite oznaku ili ograničite čekaonicu bloka {block}.

column2: The flow {flow} is ticked both “Gave up” and “Turned away”. Keep one of them.
column3: Tok {flow} je označen i kao „Odustalo”, i kao „Odbijeni”. Zadržite jednu oznaku.

column2: Set every chance of joining in the balking table of {block} to a number from 0 to 1.
column3: Postavite svaku šansu za pridruživanje u tabeli neulazaka u red bloka {block} na broj od 0 do 1.

column2: Put the rows of the balking table of {block} in increasing order of “Number waiting”.
column3: Poređajte redove tabele neulazaka u red bloka {block} rastućim redosledom „Broj na čekanju”.

column2: The flow {flow} is ticked “Balked”, but only a task with a resource and balking sends entities that balk. Untick it, or turn on balking for {block}.
column3: Tok {flow} je označen kao „Nisu ušli u red”, ali entitete koji ne ulaze u red šalje samo zadatak s resursom i uključenim neulaskom u red. Uklonite oznaku ili uključite neulazak u red za blok {block}.

column2: The flow {flow} is ticked “Balked” and also “Gave up” or “Turned away”. Keep one of them.
column3: Tok {flow} je označen kao „Nisu ušli u red” i takođe kao „Odustalo” ili „Odbijeni”. Zadržite jednu oznaku.

column2: The waiting room of {block} is set by calendar or per working server, but has no number of places, so it is unlimited. Give it a number of places, or make it fixed.
column3: Čekaonica bloka {block} zadata je po kalendaru ili po serverima u radu, ali nema broj mesta, pa je neograničena. Zadajte broj mesta ili je učinite stalnom.

column2: The waiting room of {block} is set by calendar, but no calendar has a value. Add a value for a calendar, or make the waiting room fixed.
column3: Čekaonica bloka {block} zadata je po kalendaru, ali nijedan kalendar nema vrednost. Dodajte vrednost za kalendar ili učinite čekaonicu stalnom.

column2: Set “Fails above, waiting per working server” of {block} to a number of 0 or more.
column3: Postavite „Ne prolazi iznad, čekajućih po serveru u radu” bloka {block} na broj 0 ili više.

column2: Set “Check every” of {block} to a mean above 0.
column3: Postavite „Provera svakih” bloka {block} na srednju vrednost iznad 0.

column2: Set the demand of {block} to a number of parts above 0.
column3: Postavite potražnju bloka {block} na broj delova iznad 0.

column2: The demand of {block} is per shift but names no calendar to say when the shifts are. Choose a calendar.
column3: Potražnja bloka {block} je po smeni, ali ne imenuje kalendar koji kaže kada su smene. Izaberite kalendar.

column2: The demand of {block} names a calendar that does not exist. Choose a calendar that exists.
column3: Potražnja bloka {block} imenuje kalendar koji ne postoji. Izaberite kalendar koji postoji.

column2: The probability {value} on the flow {flow} is not from 0 to 1. Enter a probability from 0 to 1.
column3: Verovatnoća {value} na toku {flow} nije od 0 do 1. Unesite verovatnoću od 0 do 1.

column2: The probabilities of the flows out of {block} add up to {sum}, not 1, so they are used in proportion. Change them to add up to 1 if that is not what you want.
column3: Verovatnoće tokova iz bloka {block} sabiraju se u {sum}, a ne u 1, pa se koriste proporcionalno. Ako to ne želite, promenite ih tako da zbir bude 1.

column2: The condition on the flow {flow} cannot be used: {error}. Correct “{expression}”.
column3: Uslov na toku {flow} ne može da se koristi: {error}. Ispravite „{expression}”.

column2: The condition on the flow {flow} is ignored, because only flows out of a Decision block choose a route. Remove the condition.
column3: Uslov na toku {flow} se zanemaruje, jer rutu biraju samo tokovi iz bloka „Odluka”. Uklonite uslov.

column2: The probability on the flow {flow} is ignored, because only flows out of a Decision block choose a route. Remove the probability.
column3: Verovatnoća na toku {flow} se zanemaruje, jer rutu biraju samo tokovi iz bloka „Odluka”. Uklonite verovatnoću.

column2: The condition on the flow {flow} is ignored, because the Decision sends entities to the shortest queue. Remove the condition.
column3: Uslov na toku {flow} se zanemaruje, jer „Odluka” šalje entitete u najkraći red. Uklonite uslov.

column2: The probability on the flow {flow} is ignored, because the Decision sends entities to the shortest queue. Remove the probability.
column3: Verovatnoća na toku {flow} se zanemaruje, jer „Odluka” šalje entitete u najkraći red. Uklonite verovatnoću.

column2: The default on the flow {flow} is ignored, because the Decision sends entities to the shortest queue. Remove the default.
column3: Oznaka „podrazumevani” na toku {flow} se zanemaruje, jer „Odluka” šalje entitete u najkraći red. Uklonite je.

column2: The probability on the flow {flow} is ignored, because the Decision routes by condition. Remove the probability.
column3: Verovatnoća na toku {flow} se zanemaruje, jer „Odluka” bira rutu po uslovu. Uklonite verovatnoću.

column2: The default flow of {block} is not one of its own flows out. Choose one of the flows out of {block} as the default.
column3: Podrazumevani tok bloka {block} nije jedan od njegovih izlaznih tokova. Izaberite kao podrazumevani jedan od izlaznih tokova bloka {block}.

column2: {block} routes by condition but has no default flow, so an entity for which no condition holds leaves the model here. Choose a default flow.
column3: Blok {block} bira rutu po uslovu, ali nema podrazumevani tok, pa entitet za koji ne važi nijedan uslov ovde napušta model. Izaberite podrazumevani tok.

column2: {block} diverts entities but has no default flow, so an entity whose way is full has nowhere else to go. Choose a default flow.
column3: Blok {block} preusmerava entitete, ali nema podrazumevani tok, pa entitet čiji je put pun nema kuda drugde. Izaberite podrazumevani tok.

column2: {block} waits for an entity on the flow {flow}, which none can reach, so it never sends one on. Remove that flow, or connect it to a block that entities reach.
column3: Blok {block} čeka entitet na toku {flow}, do koga nijedan ne može da stigne, pa nikada ništa ne šalje dalje. Uklonite taj tok ili ga povežite sa blokom do koga entiteti stižu.

column2: {block} has a limited waiting room and is fed through {gateway}. While it is full, {gateway} holds up every entity behind it, and they wait before it without limit. Remove the gateway before {block}, or remove the limit.
column3: Blok {block} ima ograničenu čekaonicu i napaja se preko {gateway}. Dok je puna, {gateway} zadržava svaki entitet iza sebe i oni čekaju ispred bez ograničenja. Uklonite kapiju pre bloka {block} ili uklonite ograničenje.

column2: The limited waiting rooms of {loop} feed each other in a loop, so when all of them are full the loop deadlocks. Remove the limit on one of them, or break the loop.
column3: Ograničene čekaonice u {loop} napajaju jedna drugu u petlji, pa kada su sve pune, petlja zapada u ćorsokak. Uklonite ograničenje sa jedne od njih ili prekinite petlju.

column2: The pool {block} has no units. Give it at least 1 unit.
column3: Fond {block} nema jedinica. Dajte mu najmanje 1 jedinicu.

column2: {block} names no resource it needs. Add one under “Needs”.
column3: Blok {block} ne imenuje nijedan resurs koji mu treba. Dodajte jedan u polju „Zahtevi”.

column2: {block} needs a resource pool that does not exist. Choose a pool that exists.
column3: Bloku {block} treba fond resursa koji ne postoji. Izaberite fond koji postoji.

column2: {block} needs units with the roles {roles}, which no pool has. Give a pool those roles, or change what {block} needs.
column3: Bloku {block} su potrebne jedinice sa ulogama {roles}, koje nema nijedan fond. Dajte nekom fondu te uloge ili promenite šta je potrebno bloku {block}.

column2: {block} needs {needed} units at once, but at most {available} exist, so this can never be met. Ask for fewer units, or add units to the pool.
column3: Bloku {block} treba {needed} jedinica odjednom, a postoji najviše {available}, pa to nikada ne može da se ispuni. Zatražite manje jedinica ili dodajte jedinice u fond.

column2: Set the priority of {block} to a finite number, not {value}.
column3: Postavite prioritet bloka {block} na konačan broj, a ne na {value}.

column2: No task uses the pool {block}. Add it to a task's needs, or remove the pool.
column3: Nijedan zadatak ne koristi fond {block}. Dodajte ga u zahteve zadatka ili uklonite fond.

column2: {block} has a value for a calendar that does not exist. Choose a calendar that exists, or remove the value.
column3: Blok {block} ima vrednost za kalendar koji ne postoji. Izaberite kalendar koji postoji ili uklonite vrednost.

column2: The calendar {block} has no entries, so it is never active. Add an entry.
column3: Kalendar {block} nema stavki, pa nikada nije aktivan. Dodajte stavku.

column2: {block} allows no arrivals outside the calendars but names no calendar, so it never creates entities. Add arrivals by calendar, or allow arrivals outside calendars.
column3: Blok {block} ne dozvoljava dolaske van kalendara, ali ne imenuje kalendar, pa nikada ne stvara entitete. Dodajte dolaske po kalendaru ili dozvolite dolaske van kalendara.

column2: Set the batch size of {block} to 1 or more.
column3: Postavite veličinu serije bloka {block} na 1 ili više.

column2: Set “{field}” of the conveyor {block} to a finite number above 0.
column3: Postavite „{field}” transportera {block} na konačan broj iznad 0.

column2: Set “{field}” of the conveyor {block} to a finite number of 0 or more.
column3: Postavite „{field}” transportera {block} na konačan broj 0 ili više.

column2: Set “{field}” of the conveyor {block} to a finite number other than 0.
column3: Postavite „{field}” transportera {block} na konačan broj različit od 0.

column2: The conveyor {block} is {length} long but each entity takes {pitch} (item length plus gap), so not even one fits. Lengthen the conveyor, or shorten the item or the gap.
column3: Transporter {block} je dugačak {length}, a svaki entitet zauzima {pitch} (dužina predmeta plus razmak), pa ne staje ni jedan. Produžite transporter ili skratite predmet ili razmak.

column2: The drawn path of the conveyor {block} is {path_length} long, but its “Length” is {length}, so the drawing and the run disagree. Make “Length” match the path, or change the shape.
column3: Nacrtana putanja transportera {block} dugačka je {path_length}, a njegova „Dužina” je {length}, pa se crtež i pokretanje ne slažu. Uskladite „Dužina” sa putanjom ili promenite oblik.

column2: {block} is a transport, which StochCraft does not simulate yet. Remove it to run the model.
column3: Blok {block} je transport, koji StochCraft još ne simulira. Uklonite ga da biste pokrenuli model.

column2: The pool {pool} of the transport {block} does not exist. Choose a pool that exists.
column3: Fond {pool} transporta {block} ne postoji. Izaberite fond koji postoji.

column2: The pool {pool} of the transport {block} is not mobile. Give the pool speeds and a home.
column3: Fond {pool} transporta {block} nije pokretan. Dajte fondu brzine i polazište.

column2: Set “{field}” of the pool {block} to a finite number above 0.
column3: Postavite „{field}” fonda {block} na konačan broj iznad 0.

column2: The home of the pool {block} is not a block of the model. Choose a block as its home.
column3: Polazište fonda {block} nije blok modela. Izaberite blok kao njegovo polazište.

column2: The transport {block} needs one block before it, where it picks up, and one after it, where it drops off, but has {inputs} before and {outputs} after. Connect it to one block on each side.
column3: Transportu {block} treba jedan blok pre njega, odakle preuzima, i jedan posle njega, gde istovara, ali ima {inputs} pre i {outputs} posle. Povežite ga sa po jednim blokom sa svake strane.

column2: {other} has no place on the canvas, so the distances for {block} are not known. Place {other} on the canvas.
column3: Blok {other} nema mesto na glavnoj površini, pa rastojanja za {block} nisu poznata. Postavite {other} na glavnu površinu.

column2: The flow {flow} asks for no entities. Set its “Units” to 1 or more.
column3: Tok {flow} ne traži nijedan entitet. Postavite njegove „Jedinice” na 1 ili više.

column2: The “Units” on the flow {flow} is ignored, because only a Split or join block takes several entities from one flow. Remove it.
column3: „Jedinice” na toku {flow} se zanemaruju, jer više entiteta iz jednog toka uzima samo blok „Razdvoji ili spoji”. Uklonite ih.

column2: No block makes batches, so {block} passes every entity through. Add a Batch block before it, or remove {block}.
column3: Nijedan blok ne pravi serije, pa {block} propušta svaki entitet. Dodajte blok „Serija” pre njega ili uklonite {block}.

column2: The stop condition names a block that does not exist. Choose a block that exists.
column3: Uslov zaustavljanja imenuje blok koji ne postoji. Izaberite blok koji postoji.

column2: Set the count of the stop condition for {block} to 1 or more.
column3: Postavite broj u uslovu zaustavljanja za blok {block} na 1 ili više.

column2: The stop condition waits for {block} to empty, but only a task can empty. Choose a task.
column3: Uslov zaustavljanja čeka da se blok {block} isprazni, ali može da se isprazni samo zadatak. Izaberite zadatak.

column2: The stop condition at {block} can be met before the warm-up ends. A run that stops during the warm-up has no statistics after it and is left out of the results. Shorten the warm-up, or stop later.
column3: Uslov zaustavljanja kod bloka {block} može biti ispunjen pre kraja zagrevanja. Pokretanje koje stane tokom zagrevanja nema statistiku posle njega i izostavlja se iz rezultata. Skratite zagrevanje ili stanite kasnije.

column2: Every run stopped before the warm-up ended, so no metric is reported. Shorten the warm-up, or stop later.
column3: Svako pokretanje je stalo pre kraja zagrevanja, pa se ne izveštava nijedna metrika. Skratite zagrevanje ili stanite kasnije.

column2: {replications} of {of} runs stopped before the warm-up ended, so their statistics are left out of every metric. Shorten the warm-up, or stop later.
column3: {replications} od {of} pokretanja stalo je pre kraja zagrevanja, pa je njihova statistika izostavljena iz svake metrike. Skratite zagrevanje ili stanite kasnije.

column2: {block} is offered {load}% of the work its units can do, so its waiting room grows without limit and the results describe no steady state. Add units, or shorten the service.
column3: Bloku {block} se nudi {load}% posla koji njegove jedinice mogu da obave, pa njegova čekaonica raste bez granice, a rezultati ne opisuju stabilno stanje. Dodajte jedinice ili skratite posluživanje.

column2: {block} is busy {utilisation}% of the time, and at the end at least {backlog} entities are still waiting against {left} that left. Work arrives faster than it is done, so the results describe no steady state. Add units, or shorten the service.
column3: Blok {block} je zauzet {utilisation}% vremena, a na kraju bar {backlog} entiteta još čeka naspram {left} koji su otišli. Posao stiže brže nego što se obavlja, pa rezultati ne opisuju stabilno stanje. Dodajte jedinice ili skratite posluživanje.

column2: The experiment has one run, so its results cannot be told from chance. Set the number of runs to at least 2, and usually 10 or more.
column3: Eksperiment ima jedno pokretanje, pa se njegovi rezultati ne mogu razlikovati od slučajnosti. Postavite broj pokretanja na najmanje 2, a obično 10 ili više.

column2: {block} has a three-point estimate but no time to fit it to, so the estimate is ignored. Remove the estimate.
column3: Blok {block} ima procenu u tri tačke, ali nema vreme na koje bi se prilagodila, pa se procena zanemaruje. Uklonite procenu.

column2: The three-point estimate of {block} cannot be fitted: every point must be a finite number. Correct the points.
column3: Procena bloka {block} u tri tačke ne može da se prilagodi: svaka tačka mora biti konačan broj. Ispravite tačke.

column2: The three-point estimate of {block} cannot be fitted: the points must be in order, minimum, most likely, then maximum or 95th percentile. Correct the points.
column3: Procena bloka {block} u tri tačke ne može da se prilagodi: tačke moraju biti po redu, minimum, najverovatnija vrednost, pa maksimum ili 95. percentil. Ispravite tačke.

column2: The three-point estimate of {block} cannot be fitted: log-normal and Weibull estimates have no maximum. Give a 95th percentile instead.
column3: Procena bloka {block} u tri tačke ne može da se prilagodi: log-normalne i Vajbulove procene nemaju maksimum. Zadajte umesto njega 95. percentil.

column2: The time of {block} is no longer the one fitted from its three-point estimate. Fit it again, or remove the estimate.
column3: Vreme bloka {block} više nije ono prilagođeno iz njegove procene u tri tačke. Prilagodite ga ponovo ili uklonite procenu.

column2: In “{field}” of {block}, the normal distribution draws below 0 more than 1 time in 100, and each such draw counts as 0, so the times are longer on average than its mean. Use a truncated normal with a minimum of 0, or a log-normal.
column3: U polju „{field}” bloka {block} normalna raspodela daje vrednosti ispod 0 češće od 1 put u 100, a svaka takva vrednost se računa kao 0, pa su vremena u proseku duža od njene srednje vrednosti. Koristite odsečenu normalnu raspodelu sa minimumom 0 ili log-normalnu.

column2: The entities of {block} do not add up: {came} came in or were inside at the start, but {went} left, were lost, gave up or are still inside.
column3: Entiteti bloka {block} se ne slažu: na početku je došlo ili bilo unutra {came}, a izašlo, izgubljeno, odustalo ili je još unutra {went}.

column2: The entities of the model do not add up: {came} were created or inside at the start, but {went} reached Departures, left the model elsewhere or are still inside.
column3: Entiteti modela se ne slažu: na početku je stvoreno ili bilo unutra {came}, a stiglo do bloka „Odlasci”, napustilo model drugde ili je još unutra {went}.

column2: No entity left the model, of {came} created or inside at the start. Check that the routing leads to Departures and that the run is long enough for an entity to get through.
column3: Nijedan entitet nije napustio model, od {came} stvorenih ili onih koji su na početku bili unutra. Proverite da li ruta vodi do bloka „Odlasci” i da li je pokretanje dovoljno dugo da entitet prođe.

column2: Little's law does not hold at {block}: the time-average number inside was {mean}, but the entities' own times inside give {from_stays}.
column3: Litlov zakon ne važi kod bloka {block}: prosečan broj unutra po vremenu bio je {mean}, a sopstvena vremena entiteta unutra daju {from_stays}.

column2: An entity that leaves a waiting room before a unit takes it, because it has waited as long as it was willing to.
column3: Entitet koji napušta čekaonicu pre nego što ga uzme jedinica, jer je čekao onoliko koliko je bio spreman.

column2: An entity that does not join a waiting room at all, because the number already waiting put it off.
column3: Entitet koji uopšte ne ulazi u čekaonicu, jer ga je odbio broj onih koji već čekaju.

column2: An entity that finds the waiting room full and takes the flow ticked “Turned away” instead of waiting.
column3: Entitet koji zatekne čekaonicu punu i umesto čekanja ide tokom označenim kao „Odbijeni”.

column2: An entity that leaves the model without reaching Departures: it found the waiting room full with nowhere else to go, or a decision with no way out for it.
column3: Entitet koji napušta model bez dolaska do bloka „Odlasci”: zatekao je čekaonicu punu bez drugog puta ili odluku bez izlaza za njega.

column2: Each entity waits here at most a time drawn for it as it arrives, then gives up: it takes the flow ticked “Gave up”, or leaves the model.
column3: Svaki entitet ovde čeka najviše vreme koje mu se nasumično odredi pri dolasku, a zatim odustaje: ide tokom označenim kao „Odustalo” ili napušta model.

column2: Entities that do not join the waiting room take this flow at once (to try again later, say), instead of being lost; they count as balked here.
column3: Entiteti koji ne uđu u čekaonicu odmah idu ovim tokom (da kasnije pokušaju ponovo, recimo), umesto da budu izgubljeni; ovde se broje kao oni koji nisu ušli u red.

column2: The job stops at once: the entity goes back to the front of the waiting room for any server on shift, and the work done on it is wasted.
column3: Posao se odmah prekida: entitet se vraća na čelo čekaonice za bilo koji server u smeni, a rad obavljen na njemu je uzaludan.

column2: The connection drops and the client tries again: the entity goes back to the front of the waiting room at once, and the work done on it is wasted.
column3: Veza pukne i klijent pokuša ponovo: entitet se odmah vraća na čelo čekaonice, a rad obavljen na njemu je uzaludan.

column2: Ticked, entities queue up at the end while the rest keep moving. Unticked, the whole belt stops when the entity at the end cannot leave.
column3: Označeno: entiteti se ređaju na kraju dok se ostali nastavljaju da se kreću. Neoznačeno: cela traka staje kada entitet na kraju ne može da izađe.
